Doing alignment on new HiFASM Genomes SISCOWET

```{bash}
04-pacbio/tools/pbmm2 index ../data/genome/pb-hifiasm-siscowet-assembly.fa ../data/genome/pb-hifiasm-siscowet-assembly.fa.pacbio.mmi
```


```{bash}
04-pacbio/tools/pbmm2 align \
../data/genome/pb-hifiasm-siscowet-assembly.fa \
../data/pacbio-reads/m84082_250614_081210_s3.hifi_reads.demux.bc2041--bc2041.bam \
../analyses/17-pacbio-align/s-bc2041.bam \
--preset CCS --sort --num-threads 48

```


```{bash}
samtools view \
-H \
../analyses/17-pacbio-align/s-bc2041.bam \
| grep '^@RG'
```
